items.title: 受OpenAI營收報告影響，英偉達、甲骨文、CoreWeave等人工智慧概念股下跌。
items.titleEn: Nvidia, Oracle, CoreWeave and other AI stocks sink on OpenAI revenue report
items.titleZh: 受OpenAI營收報告影響，英偉達、甲骨文、CoreWeave等人工智慧概念股下跌。
items.summaryEn: OpenAI has told investors that it hit roughly $50 billion in annualized revenue at the end of September, CNBC confirmed.
items.summaryZh: 根據 CNBC 證實，OpenAI 已告知投資者，截至 9 月底，其年化收入約為 500 億美元。

items.summaryEn: The S&P 500 rose to a fresh all-time intraday high on Tuesday, boosted by gains in key technology names as well as declines in oil prices and Treasury yields.
items.summaryZh: 週二，受主要科技股上漲以及油價和國債殖利率下跌的提振，標普500指數盤中創下歷史新高。
